slides.title: LLaMa 2 with 32K tokens context Original LLaMa
slides.text: LLaMa 2  with 32K tokens context Original LLaMa 2  has context length  4,096 tokens (~6 pages) It is possible to configure the model for 32K tokens (~50 pages) https://medium.com/@sushilkumar467/huge-llama-2-with-32k-context-length-9f7e11853d03 Code Llama can handle sequences of up to 100k tokens https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/code-llama-its-implications-software-development-industry-shaun-tyler/ Run models with larger context length: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yW90f1rfark https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ELax81LjFhU https://github.com/TrelisResearch/code-llama-32k https://github.com/togethercomputer/Llama-2-7B-32K-Instruct https://together.ai/blog/llama-2-7b-32k-instruct https://huggingface.co/TheBloke/Llama-2-7B-32K-Instruct-GGUF token ~ 4 chars word ~ 5 chars page ~ 500 words (single spaced) = 2.5K chars context      pages    Models -------------------------------------------- 4K          6.4     LLaMa 2, ChatGPT-3.5 8K         12.8     ChatGPT-4 (Plus) 16K         25.6 32K         50.1     ChatGpt-4 (Enterprise) 100K        150       Claude 2, Code LLaMa

slides.title: Microsoft Exposes 38TB in AI Data Leak (September
slides.text: Microsoft Exposes 38TB in AI Data Leak    (September 19, 2023) https://www.therundown.ai/p/microsoft-ai-data-leak Key points: The token granted full access to an Azure storage account , not just the intended open AI datasets. Wiz Research discovered computer backups in the data with passwords, keys, and 30,000+ internal Teams messages . Microsoft published a blog reassuring that no customer data was exposed, with no action needed from customers. Why it matters: Reminder  - tighten your AI guardrails More data - more security needed (AI - lots of data)

slides.title: Local Private Data + Embedding + VectorDB +
slides.text: Local Private Data + Embedding + VectorDB + LLM LLaMa 2 was open-sourced on July 18th, 2023 In 2 months ~1,000 variations of LLaMa were created at HuggingFace.co - improving the model, making it smaller. You can now have performance at ChatGPT-3.5 level with local open-source model running on relatively inexpensive hardware Local Components: File storage VectorDB Embedding Model LLM LangChain framework Front-end application RAG = Retrieval Augmented Generation System generates response based in the prompt with user query augmented with text retrieved from local vectorDB. The quality of RAG depends mostly on quality of the embedding model (vectors) quality of similarity search (in VectorDB) Average   ARC     HellaSwag     MMLU      TruthfulQA reason  common sense   sciences    truthful? GPT-4        84.25   96.3       95.3        86.4         59 GPT-3.5      71.93   85.2       85.5        70           47 LLaMa+ 70b   74.05   71.76      88.2        71           65.3 LLaMa+ 4bit  59.06   57.7       81.1        51.8         45.7 (13b) hybrid retrieval + semantic ranking perform better than simple Vector search https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/t5/azure-ai-services-blog/azure-cognitive-search-outperforming-vector-search-with-hybrid/ba-p/3929167

slides.title: RAG - Embedding Model and Vector Search Retriever
slides.text: RAG - Embedding Model and Vector Search Retriever VectorDB Augmented Query LLM Query Response Embedding Model - How Text Converted to Vectors Vector Search - SQL, tags, cosine similarity, etc. Example searching within a Bible text: Prompt: " who divided the waters of red sea " Good Embedding + Search : " Moses , following God’s command, stretched out his hand over the sea with his staff, and God caused the sea to be divided " Bad Embedding + Search : "And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber, which [is] beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea , in the land of Edom."

slides.title: PyQt QtCore − Core non-GUI classes used by
slides.text: PyQt QtCore − Core non-GUI classes used by other modules QtGui − Graphical user interface components QtMultimedia − Classes for low-level multimedia programming QtNetwork − Classes for network programming QtOpenGL − OpenGL support classes QtScript − Classes for evaluating Qt Scripts QtSql − Classes for database integration using SQL QtSvg − Classes for displaying the contents of SVG files QtWebKit − Classes for rendering and editing HTML QtXml − Classes for handling XML QtWidgets − Classes for creating classic desktop-style UIs QtDesigner − Classes for extending Qt Designer Typical workflow: Use Qt Designer GUI to design the UI Save as mainwindow.ui Convert UI to Python Code: pyuic5 -x mainwindow.ui -o view.py Split code in modules (MVC): model.py - business logic controller.py - connects model and view, user I/O, updates main.py - brings everything together Qt Designer GUI https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PyQt PyQt - uses cross-platform GUI toolkit Qt (since 1998) PyQt implements ~440 classes and over 6,000 functions # pip install PyQt5 import sys from PyQt5.QtWidgets import ( QApplication, QMainWindow, QAction, QTextEdit, QVBoxLayout, QWidget) from PyQt5.QtGui import QIcon ...
